messages.content: Name three fruits that turn yellow when ripe. Write them as a comma-separated list with no other words.
banana, lemon, mango
Write a two-line note to my neighbour Mrs. Fernandes thanking her for watering my plants while I was away.

Dear Mrs. Fernandes, thank you for looking after my plants while I was away.
They are green and happy, and I owe you a box of sweets.
Give me a single sentence that explains what a rainbow is, and make sure it uses the word "sunlight".
A rainbow is a curve of colours that appears when sunlight shines through raindrops and splits into its different shades.
Ayesha is starting at a new school tomorrow. Write three questions she could ask her new classmates, numbered.

1. What is your favourite subject here?
2. Where do you usually sit at lunch?
3. Which teacher gives the most interesting lessons?
Describe the smell of rain on dry earth in under 12 words.
It smells fresh, earthy and warm, like the ground breathing out.
List four indoor games for a rainy afternoon. Start every item with a dash, and keep each item to two words.

- Carrom board
- Card games
- Word puzzles
- Treasure hunt
Write a sentence about a cat sleeping in the sun, using exactly eight words.
The old grey cat dozed in warm sunlight.
My brother Kabir just passed his driving test. Write a congratulations message for him that is exactly three sentences long.
Congratulations, Kabir, you did it! All those early practice drives have paid off. Now you can take me for ice cream whenever I ask.
What are the four seasons of the year in temperate countries? Answer in one line, in the order they come, starting from spring.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter.
How do I make a jug of lemonade? Use exactly five numbered steps and keep each step under ten words.

1. Squeeze two lemons into a jug.
2. Add four spoons of sugar.
3. Pour in a litre of cold water.
4. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
5. Add ice and serve in glasses.
Can you suggest a name for a small bakery? Give three ideas, each exactly two words, and nothing else.

Morning Crust
Golden Oven
Sugar Lane
Write one sentence about a bus ride to Pune that ends with the word "window".
On the long bus ride to Pune, I spent hours watching green hills roll past my window.
Give me exactly four words that describe a good teacher, in alphabetical order, separated by commas.
caring, fair, knowledgeable, patient
Write a short weather report for a summer day in Chennai. Keep it under 25 words and do not use the word "hot".
Chennai will be sunny and very humid today, with temperatures near 38 degrees. Carry water and stay in the shade at noon.
Write an acrostic poem for the word BOOK, one line per letter.

Between the covers, a new world waits.
Old castles, ships and secret maps.
One more page, I tell myself.
Keep reading till the lamp goes out.
In exactly two sentences, tell a friend why you will be late to the party.
My train is running about forty minutes late because of track work. Please start without me, and save me a slice of cake!
List three sounds you might hear in a village at dawn. Number them and use no more than four words per item.

1. Roosters crowing loudly
2. Temple bells ringing
3. Cows lowing in sheds
Explain what a calendar is to a five-year-old. One sentence, under 20 words.
A calendar is a chart of all the days, so we know when birthdays and holidays are coming.
Give two reasons to keep a diary. Use bullet points that start with "*" and keep the whole answer under 25 words.

* It helps you remember small, happy moments.
* Writing down worries can make them feel lighter.
Write a tongue twister about a parrot in which every word starts with the letter P.
Polly's purple parrot pecked plump pink plums politely.
Suggest titles for a story about a girl who finds a lost puppy. Exactly three titles in title case, one per line.

The Puppy in the Rain
Nisha and the Brown Shadow
A Tail Comes Home
Write a reminder note for the fridge about buying milk, eggs and bread. Use all lowercase letters and keep it to one line.
don't forget: milk, eggs and bread on the way home!
Describe your ideal Sunday morning in exactly 15 words.
I wake late, drink tea on the balcony, and read the newspaper without any hurry.
Name five Indian rivers, one per line, in alphabetical order.

Brahmaputra
Ganga
Godavari
Kaveri
Narmada
Use all of these words in one sentence: kite, rooftop, wind, sister.
My sister and I flew a red kite from the rooftop when the evening wind picked up.
Write a polite request to a librarian asking to renew a book. Two sentences at most, and include the word "renew".
Could you please renew this book for me for another two weeks? I have not finished reading it yet.
Give three tips for a first day at a new job, each starting with a verb, in a numbered list.

1. Arrive ten minutes early.
2. Learn your colleagues' names.
3. Ask questions when something is unclear.
Tell me one fun fact about elephants in a single sentence of no more than 20 words.
Elephants use their trunks to drink, smell, grab food and even greet each other.
Write a haiku about a winter morning, following the 5-7-5 syllable pattern.

Cold fog on the street
Steam rises from my tea cup
The sun wakes up late
Plan a simple birthday party for a seven-year-old in exactly four numbered steps.

1. Invite six friends a week before the party.
2. Decorate the room with balloons and paper streamers.
3. Play musical chairs and pass the parcel.
4. Cut the cake and hand out small return gifts.
Say something kind to a friend after their team loses a match. Keep it under 20 words and do not use the words "lose" or "lost".
You played with your whole heart today, and I am proud of you. There is always next time.
Write three sentences about a vegetable market, each on its own line and each starting with the word "The".

The vegetable sellers call out their prices.
The air smells of coriander and ripe guavas.
The crowd moves slowly between the stalls.
Answer with exactly two words: what two things do honeybees make?
Honey, beeswax
Describe a full moon using two adjectives and one noun, nothing more.
Bright, silent lantern
Write a text to my roommate Chloe asking her to buy dish soap. One sentence only, ending with a question mark.
Chloe, could you pick up a bottle of dish soap on your way back from work?
Which days of the week start with the letter T? List them in order, separated by a slash.
Tuesday / Thursday
Write two lines to cheer up a student before an exam. The first line must be a question and the second a statement.

Have you slept well and packed your pens?
Then walk in calmly, because you have prepared for this.
Explain recycling in three short sentences for a primary school class.
Recycling means turning old things into new things. Paper, glass and plastic can be cleaned and made into fresh products. It keeps rubbish out of the ground and the sea.
Come up with a slogan for a neighbourhood cleanliness drive. It must be under eight words and must rhyme.
Keep it neat, from home to street!
List six of the seven rainbow colours, leaving out red, one per line.

Orange
Yellow
Green
Blue
Indigo
Violet
Write one sentence describing a grandfather's hands, using both "rough" and "gentle".
My grandfather's hands are rough from years of farm work, yet they are gentle when he holds a newborn calf.
How can I thank a bus driver at the end of a trip? Five words or fewer.
Thank you for the ride!
Compose a four-line poem about a street dog in which lines 2 and 4 rhyme.

He sleeps beside the corner shop,
His ears alert to every sound.
The children save him bits of bread,
And he follows them around.
I want to cook dal tonight. Give me a shopping list of exactly five ingredients, numbered.

1. Yellow lentils
2. Turmeric
3. Onion
4. Tomato
5. Cumin seeds
What is a good way to open a speech? Answer in one sentence that begins with "Start".
Start with a short story or a surprising fact so your listeners want to hear more.
Write a message to my cousin Tanvi inviting her for Diwali. Use exactly three sentences and include the word "diyas".
Tanvi, please come and spend Diwali with us this year! We will light diyas on the terrace and make rangoli together. Mum is already planning your favourite sweets.
Describe a football in three words, all beginning with the letter R.
Round, rolling, rugged
Here is a challenge: write a sentence about a train with exactly ten words and no letter "e" anywhere.
A long train ran past our farm at dawn today.
Give a two-word name for a robot that helps children with homework, and nothing else.
Homework Hero
Make a three-item checklist for leaving the house. Begin each line with a checkbox like this: [ ]

[ ] Lights and fans switched off
[ ] Gas stove turned off
[ ] Door locked and keys in my bag
Write exactly three sentences describing the sound of a tabla.
The larger drum makes a deep, booming sound. The smaller drum gives sharp, bright taps. Together they sound like a lively conversation.
Give four words for feeling happy, each with a different first letter, all lowercase, separated by commas.
cheerful, delighted, joyful, glad
Tell me what Holi is in one sentence, without using the words "colour", "colours" or "coloured".
Holi is a spring festival in India when friends and families throw bright powders and splash water at each other to celebrate the end of winter.
My piggy bank has five ten-rupee coins and three twenty-rupee notes. Give the total in words only.
One hundred and ten rupees
Write a numbered list of three ways to say goodbye in English, from most formal to most casual.

1. Goodbye, and thank you for your time.
2. See you later.
3. Bye for now!
Describe a crowded metro train in exactly 12 words.
Elbows touch, bags swing, and everyone watches the doors for their stop.
Write a get-well-soon note for my colleague Arjun. Keep it under 30 words and do not mention hospitals or medicine.
Dear Arjun, the office feels quiet without your jokes. Rest well, take your time, and come back when you feel strong again. We are all thinking of you.
Write two sentences about a lake, where the second sentence is shorter than the first.
The lake lay still beneath the hills, holding a perfect copy of the sky. A heron waited at the edge.
Explain how to brush your teeth in exactly four numbered steps.

1. Put a pea-sized dab of toothpaste on your brush.
2. Brush every tooth gently in small circles for two minutes.
3. Brush your tongue lightly.
4. Spit out the toothpaste and rinse your brush.
Give me a question I could ask a new friend to get to know them. Only one question, under 12 words.
What is something you could happily talk about for hours?
Use the word "although" in one sentence about a rainy cricket match.
Although it rained twice, the match finished before sunset and our team won by four wickets.
Name the two planets that are closer to the Sun than Earth, joined by "and". No other words.
Mercury and Venus
Write a housewarming invitation in exactly four lines, labelled Who, What, When and Where.

Who: The Mehta family
What: A housewarming lunch
When: Sunday, 14 April, at 1 p.m.
Where: Flat 302, Lotus Apartments, Nagpur
Using no more than ten words, tell me what a compass does.
A compass shows you which direction is north.
Write a Teachers' Day thank-you message that is exactly two sentences and uses the word "patience".
Thank you for your patience every time I asked the same question twice. You made maths feel possible for me this year.
Give three reasons people enjoy gardening. Start each reason with "It" and put each on a new line.

It is calming to work with soil and plants.
It feels rewarding to watch seeds grow.
It gives you fresh herbs and flowers at home.
Write a one-line caption for a photo of a sunset at the beach, in all capital letters.
GOLDEN SKY, QUIET WAVES, PERFECT END TO THE DAY
Count from one to five in words, with a hyphen between each number and a space on either side of it.
one - two - three - four - five
Describe the taste of a ripe mango in one sentence, without the word "sweet".
A ripe mango tastes rich, juicy and honeyed, with a soft tang near the skin.
Write a four-word sentence about a kitten.
The kitten chased string.
List four things you can do to calm down when you feel angry, as bullet points beginning with a dash. Keep each under six words.

- Take five slow breaths
- Walk away for a minute
- Drink a glass of water
- Count backwards from twenty
Every word must have only one syllable: write a sentence about a man waiting at a bus stop.
The man in the red coat stood at the stop and checked the time.
Suggest exactly three healthy breakfast ideas, numbered, each under eight words.

1. Poha with peas and peanuts
2. Oats with banana slices
3. Idli with sambar
Write a dialogue of exactly two lines between a shopkeeper and a customer buying apples. Start each line with the speaker's role.

Customer: How much are the apples today?
Shopkeeper: One hundred and twenty rupees a kilo, fresh from the hills.
Name three musical instruments with strings, in reverse alphabetical order, comma-separated.
violin, sitar, guitar
In under 15 words, explain why we see lightning before we hear thunder.
Light travels much faster than sound, so the flash reaches us first.
Write a two-sentence spooky story that is still suitable for young children.
Every night, I heard tiny footsteps running across the ceiling above my bed. Then Papa opened the attic and found a squirrel's nest full of my missing socks.
Include at least one number written in digits in a sentence about Independence Day.
On 15 August, our whole colony gathered at 8 in the morning to raise the flag.
Write an email subject line asking for leave on Friday. Under ten words, and no punctuation at all.
Leave request for Friday 12 July
Tell me three facts about the Himalayas, numbered, each one sentence.

1. The Himalayas stretch across several countries, including India, Nepal and Bhutan.
2. Mount Everest, the highest mountain on Earth, is part of the range.
3. Rivers such as the Ganga and the Yamuna begin in Himalayan glaciers.
Write a one-sentence review of a library you enjoyed visiting. Do not use "good" or "nice".
The town library was quiet and bright, with friendly staff and a reading corner I never wanted to leave.
Give me a sentence in the future tense about a trip to Goa, with exactly nine words.
Next month, we will take the train to Goa.
What are the three traditional primary colours of paint? One line, separated by commas.
red, yellow, blue
A two-line rhyme, please, that reminds a child to wash their hands before eating.

Before you eat your rice and dal,
Wash your hands with soap, that's all!
Describe a thunderstorm in exactly three adjectives, comma-separated.
loud, wild, electric
Write one sentence persuading a friend to join a morning walking group, ending with an exclamation mark.
Join us at six tomorrow, because the park is cool, quiet and full of birdsong at that hour!
Give the opposite of each word, in the same order, separated by commas: early, heavy, empty, ancient.
late, light, full, modern
Write instructions for feeding a goldfish in no more than three numbered steps.

1. Sprinkle a small pinch of fish flakes on the water.
2. Watch the fish eat for about two minutes.
3. Scoop out any food still floating.
Help me decline a dinner invitation politely, in under 25 words, without using the word "no".
Thank you so much for inviting me. I have a family function that evening, but I hope we can meet soon.
Write a list of five things in a classroom, one per line, each beginning with the letter C.

Chalk
Chairs
Charts
Cupboard
Clock
Tell me what a budget is in one sentence a teenager would understand.
A budget is a simple plan that shows how much money you have and how you will spend it.
Write three questions a reporter might ask the captain of a winning kabaddi team. Number them.

1. How did your team prepare for this match?
2. What was the hardest moment of the game?
3. Who would you like to thank today?
Make a sentence about a festival lamp that uses the word "bright" exactly twice.
The bright brass lamp gave the room a bright, steady glow all night.
Describe Mumbai's local trains in two sentences that both begin with "Every".
Every morning, the trains fill up with office workers and students. Every evening, the same crowds squeeze back home again.
In fewer than 20 words, what makes a good friend?
A good friend listens, keeps your secrets, and stays by your side when things get hard.
Write a menu for a simple Sunday lunch with exactly one starter, one main and one dessert, each labelled.

Starter: Tomato soup
Main: Jeera rice with rajma
Dessert: Gulab jamun
Show me alliteration in a sentence about snowfall, with at least four words starting with S.
Soft, silent snow settled slowly on the sleeping street.
I'm nervous about a dance performance tonight. Give me three short encouraging sentences, each under eight words.
You have practised this many times. Your body knows every step. Smile, breathe, and enjoy the music.
Write a dictionary-style definition of "umbrella" in under 15 words.
umbrella (noun): a folding cloth cover held overhead against rain or sun.
Plan a school-day morning routine in five lines, each starting with a time.

6:30 Wake up and make the bed
6:45 Brush teeth and take a bath
7:05 Eat breakfast with the family
7:25 Pack the school bag
7:40 Leave for the bus stop
Could you list three things a plant needs to grow? One word per item, numbered.

1. Sunlight
2. Water
3. Soil
I need a caption for my art exhibition poster. Exactly five words, with no verbs.
Colours of a Quiet Village
Sort these words alphabetically and give them on one line, separated by commas: zebra, apple, mango, kite, banyan.
apple, banyan, kite, mango, zebra
Imagine you are a postman. Describe your day in exactly three sentences, and start each one with "I".
I wake before sunrise and sort the letters at the post office. I ride my bicycle through narrow lanes, ringing the bell at every gate. I smile when an old lady waits at her door for her son's letter.
What is 15 multiplied by 4? Reply with the answer in a full sentence.
15 multiplied by 4 is 60.
Five ways to save water at home, please. Bullet points with dashes, each under seven words.

- Turn off the tap while brushing
- Take shorter showers
- Fix leaking taps quickly
- Reuse rice water for plants
- Collect rainwater in buckets
Describe a rangoli in under 20 words, using the word "symmetry".
A rangoli is a floor pattern of coloured powder or petals, often drawn with careful symmetry at festivals.
Pretend you're a cat and write two sentences about your morning, in the first person.
I stretched on the warm windowsill and ignored the alarm clock. Then I knocked a pen off the table just to watch it fall.
Make a list of three hobbies that cost little or no money: numbered, nothing else.

1. Reading library books
2. Sketching with a pencil
3. Walking in the park
Say good morning to a neighbour in a friendly way, in one sentence of exactly seven words.
Good morning, Aunty, what a lovely day!
Draft a note for a delivery person asking them to leave the parcel with the guard. No more than 15 words.
Please leave the parcel with the security guard at the main gate. Thank you!
Name four animals that live in the ocean, ordered from smallest to largest, separated by commas.
Shrimp, octopus, dolphin, blue whale
One sentence about the moon that uses a simile, please.
The full moon hung over the rooftops like a silver plate.
Explain what a library fine is to a child in exactly two sentences.
A library fine is a small amount of money you pay if you return a book late. It reminds everyone to bring books back so others can read them too.
Please give me three words that describe the sea, all ending in "-ing", comma-separated.
roaring, sparkling, shifting
Help me ask a clinic receptionist about appointment times. One polite sentence in question form.
Could you tell me which times are free for an appointment next Tuesday?
Turn this list into a single sentence: eggs, flour, sugar, butter.
To bake the cake, I need eggs, flour, sugar and butter.
Suggest a title for a song about missing home: under five words, in title case.
The Road Back Home
Write two sentences about a festival, the first in the past tense and the second in the future tense.
Last year, we celebrated Eid with my grandparents in Lucknow. This year, we will celebrate it at our new home in Hyderabad.
How would you describe a smartphone to someone from 100 years ago? One sentence under 25 words, without the word "phone".
It is a small glass slab that lets you talk to anyone, take pictures and read letters instantly.
Give me just the first line of a limerick about a goat from Ooty.
There once was a goat from Ooty
List four parts of a bicycle alphabetically, one per line, all in lowercase.

brakes
chain
pedals
wheels
At sea level, what is the boiling point of water in Celsius? Answer in under eight words.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
I forgot my homework. Write a short apology to my teacher in exactly two sentences, including the word "tomorrow".
I am sorry, Ma'am, I left my homework notebook at home today. I will bring it to you first thing tomorrow.
Describe a crowded bazaar in a single line of no more than ten words.
Shouting sellers, spicy smells and shoppers squeezing between the stalls.
Give me a sentence where "festival" is the very first word.
Festival season brings our whole street out to dance and share sweets.
List the three states of matter, numbered, with one example of each in brackets.

1. Solid (ice)
2. Liquid (water)
3. Gas (steam)
Write a short motivational line for a runner that uses the word "finish" and has no more than eight words.
Every step brings you closer to the finish.
Write a postcard message from Jaipur to my friend Emma, in exactly three sentences.
Dear Emma, Jaipur is full of pink buildings and busy bazaars. Yesterday I climbed up to a fort on a hill and saw the whole city below. I wish you were here to share the kachoris with me!
Name three things that are usually round, one per line, without using the word "ball".

Coin
Plate
Wheel
Write one sentence about an old photograph that would make a reader feel nostalgic. Under 20 words.
In the faded photo, my mother is ten years old, laughing on a swing in her village.
Tell a five-year-old why we shouldn't litter, in two simple sentences.
Litter makes our streets dirty and can hurt birds and animals. When we use a bin, everyone gets a cleaner place to play.
What are the first four notes of the Indian sargam, in order? Separate them with commas.
Sa, Re, Ga, Ma
Suggest a name for a pet tortoise. Give exactly two options, joined by "or".
Pebble or Shelly
Describe a packed bus at rush hour in a sentence where every word starts with B.
Bags bump, babies bawl, bored bankers bicker beside broken benches.
Write a three-line weekend plan. Start the lines with "Saturday morning", "Saturday evening" and "Sunday", in that order.

Saturday morning: Clean my room and wash my clothes
Saturday evening: Watch a film with Riya
Sunday: Visit Nani and eat lunch together
Replace "very hungry" in "I am very hungry" with one stronger word. Keep the sentence under six words.
I am starving.
Give me two sentences describing the night sky over a village, without using the word "stars" or "star".
Far from the city lights, the sky is thick with tiny points of light. The Milky Way stretches like a pale river overhead.
My friend texted "Are you free tonight?" Help me reply yes in under ten words.
Yes, I am free after seven. What's the plan?
Make up a proverb-style sentence about patience, under 12 words.
A slow river still reaches the sea.
What do you call a baby cow, a baby dog and a baby cat? Answer on one line with commas.
calf, puppy, kitten
Write a short job advertisement for a part-time tutor in exactly four lines: role, subject, hours, contact.

Role: Part-time home tutor
Subject: Class 8 Science
Hours: 5 to 7 in the evening, Monday to Friday
Contact: Mrs. Iyer, Flat 4B, Rose Court
Explain what a full stop does, in one sentence of under 15 words.
A full stop marks the end of a statement.
Give two compliments for a friend's cooking, each on its own line and each under ten words.

This biryani is perfectly spiced and so fragrant.
You must teach me how you made this raita.
Describe a waterfall using exactly three verbs and nothing else.
crashes, foams, roars
In exactly 20 words, describe what a museum is.
A museum is a building where old, rare or beautiful objects are kept safely so that visitors can see them.
Which months have exactly 30 days? List them in calendar order, separated by commas.
April, June, September, November
I'm lost in a new town. Write a polite question asking a stranger the way to the railway station, under 15 words.
Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the railway station?
Write three lines about rain, each line exactly four words long.

Grey clouds gather overhead.
The first drops fall.
Puddles shine like mirrors.
Name a vegetable for each letter in the word PEA, one per line.

Potato
Eggplant
Asparagus
